info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Unsubscription API allows users to opt-out of receiving weather alerts. This endpoint is designed for individuals or organizations seeking to manage their alert preferences effectively. By sending a DELETE request, consumers can remove their subscriptions to specific weather alert notifications. Typical users include developers integrating weather services into applications that require customizable alert systems, ensuring users receive only relevant notifications. This API contributes to a tailored user experience by providing control over alert settings.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from receiving alerts. Once unsubscribed, users will no longer receive notifications related to the specified alerts.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to unsubscribe from alerts. It should contain the necessary information to identify the subscription to be canceled.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: The request body for the unsubscribe operation, indicating the alert that the user wishes to unsubscribe from.

status.description: Indicates whether the unsubscription operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for tracking purposes.

resultId.description: The ID of the result related to the unsubscription operation.

state.description: The current state of the unsubscription operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the unsubscription operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response schema for successful unsubscription operation.

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the unsubscription request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the unsubscription request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the unsubscription was done automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema containing audit information for the unsubscription operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken, in milliseconds, to process the request.
